The '''Ossified Blade''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained as a possible reward in the chest at floor 90 of [[the Mines]] if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game. It can also be found from opening a [[Mystery Box]] or [[Golden Mystery Box]] at the [[Blacksmith]].
